name: Diseases
overview: Scripture reveals that diseases are both a consequence of sin and a condition from which God offers healing and protection to His people. In Exodus, God promises to remove sickness and diseases from those who obey His commandments, demonstrating His power as the Lord who heals. The troubling of Saul by an evil spirit, as described in 1 Samuel, illustrates the spiritual dimensions linked to physical and mental afflictions. Additionally, the narrative in 2 Kings highlights the vulnerability of children to disease, emphasizing the real human suffering involved. Together, these passages affirm God's sovereign authority over health and illness and call believers to trust in His healing provision.
